remark: Both exceptions are thrown by `getUpperBounds()` when the upper bounds of the wildcard type are problematic. `TypeNotPresentException` occurs if a bound refers to a type that does not exist (e.g., a class not on the classpath). `MalformedParameterizedTypeException` occurs if a bound is a parameterized type that cannot be instantiated (e.g., due to invalid arguments). The code does not validate the bounds before calling `getUpperBounds()`, so these exceptions can be triggered by malformed or missing type declarations.
